name: Daybreak
identity_check: Confirmed as Daybreak (daybreakventures.com; the site brands it 'DAYBREAK', press calls it Daybreak Ventures), the New York (SoHo) early-stage venture firm founded by Rex Woodbury (ex-Index Ventures, author of the Digital Native Substack) with partner Jared Newman. Fortune (2025-03-14) reported its $33M first fund; Woodbury's Digital Native post (2026-06-26) announced $75M Fund II plus the $25M Daybreak Meridian vehicle. A round is attributed to this firm only when the company also appears on daybreakventures.com or in Woodbury's fund posts. Not the other 'Daybreak' names that surfaced in searches: Daybreak the AI supply-chain planning software company, Daybreak Health (teen mental health), Daybreak Game Company (EverQuest publisher), the Daybreak community in Salt Lake City, Daybreak LLC (federal AI firm bought by Statecraft), or a 'Daybreak Ventures' database profile placed in The Hague.

thesis_text.value: Small, self-described 'artisanal' first-check fund that backs exceptional founders at pre-seed and seed, often before a company or idea exists, and then follows on as they scale. Fairly sector-agnostic across consumer and enterprise, focused on internet, software and AI applications; the bar is a business that could support $1B+ in revenue, built by fast-moving, AI-native founders.
thesis_text.snippet: We focus on technology’s application layer: internet, software, and AI applications with the potential for viral adoption and typically with a network effect.

Portfolio count not reported; the site says only 'a portfolio of many companies' and lists 12 example founders.
Nothing on investing in Indian founders or requiring a US entity; the firm says it invests 'across geographies', and Peripheral Labs is in Toronto.

Fund legal names, final-close dates and Form D filings not checked (SEC EDGAR not tried). The WSJ Pro story on Fund II returned 401. Fortune names Fund I LPs Screendoor, Spheres, Atacama Ventures and Reference Capital; Woodbury's post mentions five anchor checks (two family offices, three funds of funds).

Daybreak is a participant or unspecified in every round recorded; no fetched page shows it as a named lead. Its site says it committed to lead System founder Adam's first round before incorporation, but that round's details were not found.

Partner titles: Fortune and Monday Morning call Woodbury founder; the firm's own pages give no titles. Jared Newman's background and focus were not found; his LinkedIn URL comes from Woodbury's Fund II post.
